ExtraDock 4.2.9 – Smoother, Steadier, Rock Solid! 🛠️✨

🖥️ Spaces & Docks

  • Docks Stay Put Across Spaces: Fixed docks flickering or disappearing when switching Spaces — always-visible docks no longer go missing on new desktops until a restart!
  • Smoother Fullscreen Transitions: Improved dock hide/show behavior when entering and leaving fullscreen apps!

⚡ Stability & Performance

  • No More UI Freezes: Fixed hangs that could freeze ExtraDock while other apps were launching or activating!
  • Trash Widget Crash Fix: Fixed a crash in the Trash widget's Finder integration!
  • macOS 26 Crash Fix: Fixed a window-resize crash in the management and widget settings windows on macOS 26!

🚀 What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraDock more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraDock community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make.
